reviews.comment: Understood all the conceptual stuff, only really struggled with matlab syntax, he teaches exactly how to do it his way, not necessarily the exact documentation so pay attention and write down exactly what he does cause youll struggle writing code if you don't. Otherwise one of my fav classes. Exam 2 was take home coding exam that was fun and easy

He's very nice and responds to emails relatively fast. There's quizzes every Friday and his exams can be a bit tricky, but he spends lot of time in class explaining concepts and tells you what will be on the exam. He holds lots of office hours so attend them or email him if you need help.
He is a nice guy and make class fun, the homework's and exams aren't to bad and he is a nice grader. If you can take him definitely do so you.

Great professor. Holds multiple review sessions and office hours before exams and answers our questions well. Also gives a full scouting report for each exam that tells us exactly how many questions the exams have and how many points each question's worth. Reading the textbook helps a lot.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: CHEN 364 during Spring Semester. Prof Green holds amazing lectures. Homework was very tricky but office hours were clutch. Held great reviews for all exams. All exams are open note, homework, and textbook. No curveballs. Quizzes every Thursday at start of class. For Advice: Run DB Fire through notes, homework, and textbook chapters for every exam.

It's a tough class but he makes it pretty easy. There is a lot of coding involved but he gives skeleton codes to help. His exam reviews are great and helps a lot with studying for exams. He cares a lot and offers a lot of office hours for help with homework questions. I definitely recommend him.

Dr. green claimed that he would not test over Matlab. Just finished our second exam yesterday and 29/55 points of the exam was a Matlab coding problem. DO NOT TAKE HIM unless you had him for analysis as well. Super nice guy but moves way to fast. This class was the worst. Unfortunately, your only other option is Jeong so maybe do take green...
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Green was a great professor. I like the demonstrations he does in class. Some of the HWs can take a while. TAs are helpful for the HWs. The weekly quizzes can be pretty tricky. First exam was harder than expected, and the second exam was take-home, and Dr. Green and his TA held office hours till midnight till everyone got the help they needed.

CHEN 320 during Fall Semester. Prof Green holds amazing lectures. TAs will save you on the homework. Holds great in-class reviews for exams. Is passionate about topics. 1st exam is closed note, 2nd exam is take-home, and final is open note, homework, and textbook. Exams were very fair. Quizzes are every friday at beginning of class. Can be tricky!

This is just a really hard class, not much Dr. Green can do about that. That said, he's a nice enough guy. Homework is pretty challenging, as are the tests, though they're open book and open notes. Be prepared to do a lot of coding for this class.
Just took mid term 2. It was extremely hard. Didn't study much tho.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Tenet problem, Car wash problem, Hat problem, what are you even talking about Dr. Green lmao. Says it isn't a matlab class then you gotta code the entire homework. Doesn't do any examples in class then expects you to know it for the exam. Doesn't give solutions for the homework. How am I supposed to study for my exam tomorrow? Guess I'll take an L.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Does not post homework answers, and then expects you to learn. Like how do I know what I got wrong if don't have the solutions. Preparing for exams are impossible since it is based on the homework, which you just happened to get all wrong.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
Micah Green is the most overrated professor ever. Don't get me wrong, he's a good dude. His passion and energy gets him a high rating.

But if you're the type of person that learns from doing problems in class, he is the worst professor to take. Bro just teaches you random concepts, and leaves you for dry for the homework/exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Such a mean man. He is a good professor, but he has been bullying the same girl in my class for the past two semesters, and I feel so bad for her. He is so mean to her, but she just wants to learn and ask questions. He is a complete savage and not the good kind. It makes the exams awful and says that they are easy. Bestie... No. Just pls no.

I mean... He's a good professor but a complete butthole. I am sitting here in an exam review, and he is being so sassy and mean to people. Like ouch. You learn a lot, but he purposely tries to make the exams tricky, and it's so silly. Very arrogant, snobbish, and mean.

Dr. Green is my fav CHEN prof so far. His lectures were clear, and he was always available at office hours for homework questions. He is quick to responds to his emails and you can tell he clearly cares for his students. This class required a lot of time and effort, but it was always fulfilling to finish an assignment.

Dr. Green loves the class and the material. He is very passionate about developing your intuition which is great. His exams can be very tricky and he is very upfront about the fact that he will put trick questions on them. He is very accessible during office hours and via email. He is very quick to respond and gave opportunities for bonuses.

Professor explains theory in lecture but at least in my year didn't give many examples. Apparently in the past he would give examples of code but this year that wasn't done so there was no way to solve anything without going to office hours. His exams often focus on parts of the class you don't even cover in the homework.

Dr. Green is the man. He always goes the extra mile with homework help, and explaining concepts so that the students can understand them better. His lectures are very entertaining, although they are noticeably faster paced than most. Homework assignments are long and challenging, but he provides tons of help. You won't regret his kinetics class.
A solid professor. Tophat quizzes almost every lecture. Material on the exams is straightforward if the exam review and the homeworks are well understood.
The class was not too bad but he does not use eCampus. The final exam was very tricky despite him telling us that there would be no surprises.

Analysis with Green was one of the easier courses I've taken in the department. Linear Algebra and familiarity with MATLAB make this class pretty straightforward. Put the time in to learn how to use MATLAB to solve the problems given and you'll do fine. Understanding the homeworks/assignments is vital to doing well on the exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Green is a really great professor with lectures that clearly explain the material. His HW and tests are difficult, but feasible if you take good notes and pay close attention to his lectures. He takes attendance through Tophat quizzes 50% of the time. He is very accessible outside of class and loves it when students email him questions.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Best professor in the CHEN department. Really cares about the material and that you learn it, often going out of his way to explain concepts in ways that he isn't a fan of if he knows it'll work for us. Not easy, but replies to emails instantly, and the homeworks really solidify concepts from class. Brilliant guy. Wish he'd teach all my classes.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Green is the best professor I have ever had. He is fair and has the best distribution in the whole department. His homeworks can be tough but they are made to teach you the material and prepare you for the exams. He is always willing to help you at any times of the day (I once email him at 2 AM and got a response). His lectures are entertaining
